faq_heading: Questions IT services firms ask about a LinkedIn outreach agent

faqs.q: Can a LinkedIn outreach agent find CTOs and operations heads for my IT services firm?
faqs.a: Yes. You name the roles, industries, company sizes and regions, and the agent looks for matching people, such as CTOs at mid-size manufacturers or operations heads at logistics firms. You approve the target list first.

faqs.q: Will the messages sound like generic software sales spam?
faqs.a: They should not. Each note is short and built from facts you approve: who you help, a problem you solve and a true example. You can read and change the wording at any time.

faqs.q: Does it work for long IT sales cycles?
faqs.a: It helps with the start of the cycle: reaching the right people, following up and sorting replies. A person from your team still runs discovery, scoping and proposals, which is where deals are won.
Warm replies reach you on WhatsApp with the conversation, so a founder or sales lead can take the call. Follow-ups stop the moment someone replies.

faqs.q: How soon can we see whether it works for our firm?
faqs.a: We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days. After going live, judge it over a full month on four numbers: people reached, acceptances, real replies and booked calls.
